scripts.script:
-- Flash Auto Suite
-- Clean rewrite for Rebirth, Coins, Loot, Craft

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local SoundService = game:GetService("SoundService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local CoreGui = game:GetService("CoreGui")

local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

-- Clean up existing UIs
pcall(function() CoreGui:FindFirstChild("Flash_Suite"):Destroy() end)
pcall(function() PlayerGui:FindFirstChild("Flash_Suite"):Destroy() end)
pcall(function() CoreGui:FindFirstChild("Flash_Splash"):Destroy() end)

-- Quick Sound helper
local function playSound(id, pitch, vol)
    task.spawn(function()
        local s = Instance.new("Sound")
        s.SoundId = "rbxassetid://" .. tostring(id)
        s.Volume = vol or 0.3
        s.PlaybackSpeed = pitch or 1
        s.Parent = SoundService
        s:Play()
        s.Ended:Connect(function() s:Destroy() end)
    end)
end

-- Config & State
local Config = {
    Rebirth = false, RebirthDelay = 0.1, Burst = false, BurstAmount = 5,
    Coins   = false, CoinDelay   = 0.5,
    Loot    = false, LootDelay   = 0.2,
    Craft   = false, CraftDelay  = 0.3
}

local State = {
    Rebirths = 0,
    Status = "Idle"
}

-- Remote References
local EF = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("E&F")
local RebirthRE = EF:WaitForChild("Train"):WaitForChild("RebirthRE")
local GetOfflineCoins = EF:WaitForChild("Offline"):WaitForChild("GetOfflineCoins")
local AddEcoRE = EF:WaitForChild("Eco"):WaitForChild("AddEcoRE")
local DoLuckRF = EF:WaitForChild("Equipment"):WaitForChild("DoLuckRF")
local CraftAllRE = EF:WaitForChild("Equipment"):WaitForChild("CraftAllRE")

-- Actions
local function doRebirth()
    if Config.Burst then
        local done = 0
        for _ = 1, Config.BurstAmount do
            if pcall(function() RebirthRE:FireServer() end) then done += 1 end
        end
        State.Rebirths += done
        State.Status = "Burst +" .. done
    else
        if pcall(function() RebirthRE:FireServer() end) then
            State.Rebirths += 1
            State.Status = "Rebirthed ✓"
        else
            State.Status = "Failed"
        end
    end
end

local function giveCoins()
    pcall(function() GetOfflineCoins:FireServer(9e300) end)
    pcall(function() AddEcoRE:FireServer("coin", 9e300, "Stage") end)
end

local function openLoot()
    pcall(function() DoLuckRF:InvokeServer("neck", "Event1", 1) end)
end

local function craftAll()
    pcall(function() CraftAllRE:FireServer() end)
end

    TweenService:Create(skipBtn, info, {BackgroundTransparency = 1, TextTransparency = 1}):Play()
    task.wait(0.55)

-- Drag logic (Mobile + Mouse)
local function makeDraggable(frame, dragHandle)
    dragHandle = dragHandle or frame
    local dragging, dragInput, dragStart, startPos

    dragHandle.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            dragging = true
            dragStart = input.Position
            startPos = frame.Position

            input.Changed:Connect(function()
                if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then dragging = false end
            end)
        end
    end)

    dragHandle.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            dragInput = input
        end
    end)

    UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if input == dragInput and dragging then
            local delta = input.Position - dragStart
            frame.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
        end
    end)
end

-- Tabs Setup
local TABS = {"⚡ Rebirth", "💰 Coins", "🎲 Loot", "🔨 Craft"}

local tabPages = {}
local activeTab = 1

local function switchTab(idx)
    if activeTab == idx then return end
    playSound(6895470002, 1, 0.3)
    activeTab = idx
    for i, btn in ipairs(tabBtns) do
        if i == idx then
            btn.BackgroundColor3 = Colors.Card
            btn.TextColor3 = Colors.Accent
        else
            btn.BackgroundColor3 = Colors.Hdr
            btn.TextColor3 = Colors.SubText
        end
    end
    for i, page in ipairs(tabPages) do
        page.Visible = (i == idx)
    end
end

for i, title in ipairs(TABS) do

    btn.BackgroundColor3 = Colors.Hdr

    btn.TextColor3 = Colors.SubText
    btn.LayoutOrder = i
    Instance.new("UICorner", btn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 5)
    tabBtns[i] = btn

    local page = Instance.new("Frame", Body)

    page.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    page.Visible = false
    tabPages[i] = page

-- Helper Components
local function addCard(page, order, txt, color)

    local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", f)
    stroke.Color = Colors.Stroke
    stroke.Thickness = 1

    local lbl = Instance.new("TextLabel", f)

    lbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    lbl.Text = txt
    lbl.TextSize = 10
    lbl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    lbl.TextColor3 = color or Colors.Accent

end

    lbl.Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0, 0)
    lbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    lbl.Text = labelText
    lbl.TextSize = 10
    lbl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamSemibold
    lbl.TextColor3 = Colors.Text
    lbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left

    local pill = Instance.new("TextButton", row)
    pill.Size = UDim2.new(0, 42, 0, 18)
    pill.Position = UDim2.new(1, -48, 0.5, -9)
    pill.BackgroundColor3 = Colors.Off
    pill.Text = "OFF"
    pill.TextSize = 9
    pill.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    pill.TextColor3 = Colors.SubText
    pill.BorderSizePixel = 0
    Instance.new("UICorner", pill).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 9)

    local enabled = false
    pill.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        playSound(6895079853, 1.1, 0.3)
        enabled = not enabled
        if enabled then
            pill.BackgroundColor3 = Colors.On
            pill.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
            pill.Text = "ON"
        else
            pill.BackgroundColor3 = Colors.Off
            pill.TextColor3 = Colors.SubText
            pill.Text = "OFF"
        end
        if callback then callback(enabled) end
    end)
    return row, pill
end

local function addDelay(page, defaultVal, minVal, order, callback)

    row.BackgroundTransparency = 1

                applyBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 120, 200)

            end)
        end
    end)
    return row
end

scripts.script:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local running = false
local spamSpeed = 0.01
local amountPerSpam = 1e303 -- safe huge value

-- Remotes
local EF = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("E&F")
local getOfflineCoins = EF.Offline.GetOfflineCoins
local addEco = EF.Eco.AddEcoRE
local rebirth = EF:WaitForChild("Train"):WaitForChild("RebirthRE")

-- ===== SCREEN GUI =====
local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name = "ToggleSpamGui"
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
gui.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local alive = true -- controls loops

-- ===== MAIN FRAME =====
local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
frame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 340, 0, 200)
frame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -170, 0.5, -100)
frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 30)
frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
frame.Parent = gui
frame.Active = true
frame.Draggable = true

local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 12)
corner.Parent = frame

-- ===== HEADER =====
local header = Instance.new("TextLabel")
header.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 40)
header.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
header.BackgroundTransparency = 1
header.Text = "Spam Controller"
header.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 215, 0)
header.TextScaled = true
header.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
header.Parent = frame

-- ===== MAIN TOGGLE BUTTON =====
local toggleButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
toggleButton.Size = UDim2.new(0, 300, 0, 50)
toggleButton.Position = UDim2.new(0, 20, 0, 50)
toggleButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50, 50, 50)
toggleButton.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
toggleButton.TextScaled = true
toggleButton.Text = "SPAM: OFF"
toggleButton.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
toggleButton.Parent = frame

local toggleCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
toggleCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)
toggleCorner.Parent = toggleButton

toggleButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	running = not running
	toggleButton.Text = running and "SPAM: ON" or "SPAM: OFF"
	toggleButton.BackgroundColor3 = running and Color3.fromRGB(40, 160, 40) or Color3.fromRGB(50, 50, 50)
	if miniToggle then
		miniToggle.Text = running and "SPAM: ON" or "SPAM: OFF"
		miniToggle.BackgroundColor3 = running and Color3.fromRGB(40, 160, 40) or Color3.fromRGB(25, 25, 25)
	end
end)

-- ===== REMOVE BUTTON =====
local removeButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
removeButton.Size = UDim2.new(0, 50, 0, 25)
removeButton.Position = UDim2.new(1, -60, 0, 10)
removeButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(180, 40, 40)
removeButton.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
removeButton.TextScaled = true
removeButton.Text = "X"
removeButton.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
removeButton.Parent = frame

local removeCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
removeCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
removeCorner.Parent = removeButton

removeButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	frame.Visible = false -- just hide main GUI instead of destroying
end)

-- ===== SPEED SLIDER LABEL =====
local sliderLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
sliderLabel.Size = UDim2.new(0, 300, 0, 25)
sliderLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 20, 0, 110)
sliderLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
sliderLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
sliderLabel.TextScaled = true
sliderLabel.Text = string.format("Speed: %.3f", spamSpeed)
sliderLabel.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
sliderLabel.Parent = frame

-- ===== SLIDER FRAME =====
local sliderFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
sliderFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 300, 0, 20)
sliderFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0, 20, 0, 140)
sliderFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(80, 80, 80)
sliderFrame.Parent = frame

local sliderCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
sliderCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)
sliderCorner.Parent = sliderFrame

local sliderFill = Instance.new("Frame")
sliderFill.Size = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, 0)
sliderFill.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 160, 40)
sliderFill.Parent = sliderFrame

-- ===== SLIDER DRAG FUNCTION =====
local dragging = false
local function updateSlider(posX)
	local mouseX = math.clamp(posX - sliderFrame.AbsolutePosition.X, 0, sliderFrame.AbsoluteSize.X)
	sliderFill.Size = UDim2.new(mouseX / sliderFrame.AbsoluteSize.X, 0, 1, 0)
	spamSpeed = 0.001 + (0.1 - 0.001) * (1 - sliderFill.Size.X.Scale)
	sliderLabel.Text = string.format("Speed: %.3f", spamSpeed)
end

sliderFrame.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
		dragging = true
		updateSlider(input.Position.X)
	end
end)
sliderFrame.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
		dragging = false
	end
end)
UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
	if dragging and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
		updateSlider(input.Position.X)
	end
end)

-- ===== MINI TOGGLE =====
local miniToggle = Instance.new("TextButton")
miniToggle.Size = UDim2.new(0, 100, 0, 30)
miniToggle.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 10)
miniToggle.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(25, 25, 25)
miniToggle.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
miniToggle.TextScaled = true
miniToggle.Text = "SPAM: OFF"
miniToggle.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
miniToggle.Parent = gui

miniToggle.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	running = not running
	miniToggle.Text = running and "SPAM: ON" or "SPAM: OFF"
	miniToggle.BackgroundColor3 = running and Color3.fromRGB(40, 160, 40) or Color3.fromRGB(25, 25, 25)
	if toggleButton and toggleButton.Parent then
		toggleButton.Text = running and "SPAM: ON" or "SPAM: OFF"
		toggleButton.BackgroundColor3 = running and Color3.fromRGB(40, 160, 40) or Color3.fromRGB(50, 50, 50)
	end
end)

-- ===== SPAM + REBIRTH LOOP =====
task.spawn(function()
	while alive do
		if running then
			pcall(function()
				-- coins
				getOfflineCoins:FireServer(amountPerSpam)
				addEco:FireServer("coin", amountPerSpam, "Stage")
				-- auto rebirth
				rebirth:FireServer()
			end)
			task.wait(spamSpeed)
		else
			task.wait(0.15)
		end
	end
end)
